integrity: Explicit mathematical proof and reproducible finite corroboration are provided; no independent validation or priority certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Proved only for two identical odd-prime cycles, real homogeneous intra-cycle hopping, one positive uniform rung strength, the specific opposite-rung source and sink, and an ideal infinite-time absorbing evolution. The result is not a uniform finite-time robustness statement.
title: Isolated coupling resonances and exact quantum survival on prime-prism ladders
